# hatchway

> A narrow, logged opening through which an outside agent reaches your tools: an SSH forced command that runs only an allowlist kept as data


## Pages in this subsection

- [hatchway](hatchway.html.md): hatchway: a narrow, logged opening through which an outside agent reaches your tools.
- [hatchway.config](hatchway.config.html.md): Where hatchway keeps its configuration and its records, and how a profile is found.
- [hatchway.install](hatchway.install.html.md): Putting a hatch on a machine: the &#96;authorized_keys&#96; line, the snapshot timer, the skills.
- [hatchway.policy](hatchway.policy.html.md): The allowlist: which command lines an outside agent may run, decided without running anything.
